notes.title: Fixed Chinese Language Bug
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with the game not automatically switching to Chinese due to a mismatch between what the localisation system expected the language to be called and what the operating system reported. It should now work as expected. 

Language selection now also queries the operating system every time the game launches rather than just the first time it runs. 

[img]https://www.correctuniverse.com/BlocksplodeChinese.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Explosive Developer update!
notes.content:
What a blast March has been so far!

We’ve been working on some explosive developments since Blocksplode’s Demo debuted in Steam’s February Games Festival last month and have a lot of exciting news to share with you.

The background graphics have now been reworked with a focus on changing the original floating islands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/73f5bed7106bc6f62060305a62839cc15230b910.png[/img]

The background rock geometry and materials have been modified so they now match perfectly with the cleaner look of the blocks and pool area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/dea8d89c77824a3a99eade3f394c20e2cc31664d.png[/img]

We’ve added to the visual interest with the addition of rounded grass mounds, blocky trees, smaller rocks, grass tufts and flowers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/b63daabe471463c4384b57b572e45c84259a5ac1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/1a1ff0e4c31927fb85b5c2d1742dea3318c87576.png[/img]

We’re now eager to start working on a brand new desert island background that will liven up select levels and turn up the heat! Stay tuned…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34979041/a916b05aaebd941d49f0c70f40682460e947d268.png[/img]

Till next time!

Nick

The North Star Games Team
